title: Undisclosed and inconsistent Implied EV/EBITDA convention in Ratio_Analysis!K41:O41 causes valid period-specific solutions to score 0.0
evidence: In problem.py, the prompt states: 'In the Ratio Analysis sheet, calculate EV/EBITDA for all periods, then calculate Implied EV/EBITDA for forecast years only (2014F–2018F).' In 'Ratio_Analysis ', Row 32 is Market Price (K32:O32 = Valuation!$D$97), Row 33 is Enterprise Value for each period using that period's basic shares and balance sheet items (e.g., K33 = '=(K32*Financials!K61)+Financials!K101+Financials!K90+Financials!K95-Financials!K73-Financials!K74'), Row 34 is Target Price (K34:O34 = Valuation!$D$95), Row 39 is EV/EBITDA ('=K33/Financials!K17' .. '=O33/Financials!O17'), and Row 40 is Implied P/E ('=+K34/K29' .. '=+O34/O29'). Replacing Market Price (K32:O32) with Target Price (K34:O34) in Row 33's Enterprise Value formula for each forecast year yields Implied EV/EBITDA of [15.3465825604316, 14.7849300636407, 14.2447022971047, 13.7350170866250, 13.2701680805274]. However, gt_04_Consumer_golden.xlsx defines K41:O41 as '=((Valuation!$D$95*Valuation!$E$47)+Valuation!$E$41+Valuation!$E$44-Valuation!$E$42-Valuation!$E$43)/Financials!K17' (and /L17..O17), which uses 2014F diluted shares (Valuation!$E$47 = Financials!K62) and static 2013 historical Debt, Cash, Investments, and Minority Interest (Valuation!$E$41:$E$44 = Financials!J90+J95, J73, J74, J101) across all forecast years 2014F–2018F, yielding [16.6361707842035, 16.1713999759156, 15.8325628722942, 15.4502994307010, 15.0822567842166]. Because nothing in the prompt discloses using Valuation!$E$41:$E$47 instead of the Ratio_Analysis sheet's own Enterprise Value structure, all 3 runs failed on K41:O41 and received 0.0 on the sole verifier (weight: 1).

fix: prompt.md: added "For Implied EV/EBITDA, build one implied enterprise value from the Valuation sheet (Target Price times No. of shares outstanding, plus Adjustment for Debt and Minority Interest, less Cash and Marketable Securities and Investments and Others) and divide it by each forecast year's EBITDA." title: The Implied EV/EBITDA answer key uses one undisclosed bridge, so a reasonable alternative build fails the whole task
evidence: Ground truth Ratio_Analysis!K41:O41 = ((Valuation!$D$95*Valuation!$E$47)+Valuation!$E$41+Valuation!$E$44-Valuation!$E$42-Valuation!$E$43)/Financials!K17. This takes the blended target price, multiplies it by diluted shares (Financials row 62, 2,930.6) and adds a net-debt bridge fixed at 2014 levels (J-column debt 31,543, cash 5,947, minority interest 645), then divides by each year's EBITDA. Values: 16.64, 16.17, 15.83, 15.45, 15.08. The prompt only says "calculate Implied EV/EBITDA for forecast years only". The nearest pattern in the sheet is the adjacent Enterprise Value row 33: (Price × Financials row 61 basic shares) + MI + debt − cash − investments, using each year's balance sheet. The Implied P/E row next to it also uses each year's data (=K34/K29). If you mirror row 33 with Target Price K34 instead of K32, you get 15.35, 14.78, 14.24, 13.74, 13.27. That is 8–12% off the key, well outside the verifier's 1% tolerance. verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells is all-or-nothing (weight 1; every modification cell must match), so this defensible alternative scores 0 for the whole task.
confirmation: The key's K41:O41 relies on a fixed Valuation-sheet bridge that the instruction never mentions. Mirroring row 33 with Target Price (K34) gives about 15.35 vs the key's 16.64, outside the 1% tolerance, so a defensible build scores 0 overall.
fix: prompt.md: added "For Implied EV/EBITDA, build one implied enterprise value from the Valuation sheet (Target Price times No. of shares outstanding, plus Adjustment for Debt and Minority Interest, less Cash and Marketable Securities and Investments and Others) and divide it by each forecast year's EBITDA." (reproduces golden K41 = 16.636 exactly)
